title: Present Tense
objective: Talk about what you eat and drink for breakfast using present-tense verbs.
focus: Present tense of regular -ar, -er and -ir verbs: yo, tú, usted, nosotros, ellos

words.note: Fried tortilla pieces in red or green salsa; a classic Mexican breakfast.
Fried eggs, usually sunny side up, in Mexico.

words.en: I have breakfast at 8 every day.
words.es: Desayuno a las 8 todos los días.

words.en: Do you drink coffee or tea?
words.note: Informal tú: use with a fellow guest your age, not with staff.
Formal usted: polite with someone you just met.
In Mexico, tomar is the usual verb for drinking.

speaking: Chat with a fellow guest: say what you eat for breakfast, ask if they drink coffee or tea, and ask if they live here.
